assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
The symptoms are documented in the clinical indication note
CPT 93229 is associated with the clinical indication note
There is a concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion events
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances during symptom onset
The payer's denial reason code is PR-204
The service directly targets the member's documented transient cerebral ischemic attack symptoms and suspected arrhythmic cause
